reader_summary.headline: Tom Steyer is the founder and former head of Farallon Capital Management, climate activist.
reader_summary.overview: Tom Steyer is the founder and former head of Farallon Capital Management, climate activist, candidate for President of the United States in 2020, and most recently. Our conversation covers Tom's early career and founding of Farallon in 1986. We discuss his original strategy, history, and succession to new leaders at the firm.

key_points.text: Tom Steyer is the founder and former head of Farallon Capital Management, climate activist, candidate for President of the United States in 2020.
We then turn to Tom's retirement from Farallon, work on the environment, and Presidential run.
From there, we dive into Tom's return to the investment business at Galvanize, covering his investment thesis, strategies to deploy.
